title: Severe Allergic Reaction with Moderate Airway Compromise

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: I took a new medication and my face is swelling, I have hives everywhere, and my throat feels tight

conversation.speaker: assistant
conversation.text: This is a serious allergic reaction. You need to go to the emergency room or urgent care immediately. Do not delay.

sbar_structure.situation: Patient reports facial swelling, urticaria, and throat tightness after medication exposure
sbar_structure.assessment: Significant allergic reaction with early airway involvement; urgent evaluation needed
sbar_structure.recommendation: Emergency room evaluation within 30 minutes; airway monitoring; possible epinephrine
